findings.title: Shortfall and limits-file reads can block before non-regular file refusal

evidence.followup: fstat and 16MiB check only occur at lines51-52, after open returns
readLimitsFile uses path-based unbounded synchronous read after existsSync; no nonblocking regular-file admission or byte cap
existing journal reader already provides nonblocking one-FD regular-file/size/stability checks

static_counterexamples.input: measure_shortfall orders_file is an absolute named FIFO with no writer
static_counterexamples.reasoning: openSync r on a FIFO waits for a writer before the fstat regular-file check; runShortfall runs synchronously inside the MCP handler, so other requests and in-process cancellation cannot advance

static_counterexamples.input: CANLI_HOME/limits.json is a named FIFO with no writer
static_counterexamples.reasoning: existsSync reports the entry present and synchronous readFileSync waits on the FIFO. check_orders, size_position and the limits resource all reach this function; a regular-file/cap guard is absent

findings.additional_bound_gap: A regular limits.json is read fully before parsing/field validation. A supplied malformed or huge local file has no encoded-byte cap even though each validated allowlist is finite. This is distinct from journal-store payload/line caps.
findings.test_source_review: shortfall.test.mjs file controls cover stable JSON equivalence, digest, relative paths and malformed content; tools.test.mjs covers malformed/invalid limits and KILL. No FIFO/file-admission coverage is present in those frozen named tests; no test execution claimed.
findings.requested_resolution: Primary allocate an isolated narrow fix for bounded nonblocking one-FD regular-file snapshots and safe errors for both consumers. A supervised finite child regression for FIFO must have an outside kill deadline/process cleanup and an actual exact-head CI or fresh lead grant before local execution. Do not launch a FIFO probe in this reviewer process.
